resources.string: Allows the swipe-down gesture on the home screen to open the notification shade.

Tracks the currently open app to enforce focus and app-blocking limits, opens the notification shade for the swipe-down gesture, and is used as a fallback to return home when a blocked app cannot be covered by an overlay.
